title: Vietnam and Cambodia Tour Package from Chennai
highlights: Experience the best of both worlds, from cruising the Mekong Delta to exploring ancient temples, all included in one of our best Vietnam and Cambodia tour packages from Chennai.
Venture into the Cu Chi Tunnels of Vietnam to learn about their crucial role in the Vietnam War and experience life underground.
Enjoy a scenic boat ride through the Mekong Delta, where vibrant floating markets and serene landscapes await your exploration.
Explore the Royal Palace and Silver Pagoda in Cambodia, renowned for their intricate designs and historical significance in Cambodian culture.
Admire Angkor Wat, a UNESCO World Heritage Site known for its stunning symmetry and detailed bas-reliefs depicting Hindu mythology.
overview:
About the destinations:
Vietnam and Cambodia are two captivating Southeast Asian countries known for their rich history, culture, and stunning landscapes. In Vietnam, explore vibrant cities like Ho Chi Minh City and Hanoi, enjoy the breathtaking beauty of Ha Long Bay, and savour delicious street food. The warmth of the Vietnamese people adds to the charm of this destination. Cambodia is famous for the awe-inspiring Angkor Wat, a testament to the Khmer Empire's grandeur. The lively capital, Phnom Penh, features a blend of French colonial architecture and cultural heritage.


For an unforgettable adventure, consider our Vietnam and Cambodia tour packages from Chennai, which offer a variety of itineraries to suit every traveller's needs. Whether you're immersing yourself in the bustling cities or exploring the serene countryside, there's something for everyone.


Experience the best of both countries and discover unique cultural experiences with our Vietnam Cambodia tour packages from Chennai. Each package includes guided tours, comfortable accommodations, and transportation, ensuring a seamless and enjoyable trip.


Planning your next adventure? Explore our exclusive Vietnam Tour Packages for an unforgettable experience.

know_before_you_go: ID Proof is mandatory for each individual guest at the time of booking, and upon arrival. PAN Card will not be considered as a valid identity proof. All foreign nationals must carry their passport as a proof of identity.
The official currency of Vietnam is the Vietnamese Dong (VND). It’s advisable to carry some cash for small purchases, though credit cards are widely accepted.
It is advisable that you dress modestly (keeping your upper arms and legs covered) when visiting any religious sites.
Indian tourists can obtain a Vietnam visa online (E-Visa) or upon arrival at the airport with a validity of 30 days. Charges have to be paid by the tourists.
Smoking is prohibited in most public areas therefore, designated smoking areas should be used.
Always carry tissue paper or wet wipes with you as most public toilets in Vietnam do not provide them.
To mitigate health risks, it is strongly advised to refrain from drinking tap water directly in Vietnam. Instead, carry refillable water bottles.
Images are only for representation purposes.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Ho Chi Minh City | Leisure Day
days.desc: Welcome to Vietnam! Upon arrival at Tan Son Nhat International Airport in Ho Chi Minh City, get transferred to your hotel for check-in. After settling in, enjoy the day at leisure to explore the city on your own. You can visit local attractions like Ben Thanh Market or take a leisurely stroll along Nguyen Hue Walking Street. This is your time to relax and soak in the vibrant energy of Vietnam's largest metropolis. Later, return to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

Check-in at Deluxe Hotel

days.title: Ho Chi Minh City Tour | Cu Chi Tunnels Tour
days.desc: Start the day with a city tour as you get transferred to visit iconic landmarks such as the War Remnants Museum, Reunification Palace, and Saigon Central Post Office. Following this, venture to the Cu Chi Tunnels, an extensive underground network used during the Vietnam War. Learn about the tunnel system's strategic importance and the ingenuity of the soldiers. After an insightful day of exploration, get dropped off at the hotel in Ho Chi Minh City for an overnight stay.

days.title: Mekong Delta Tour
days.desc: Embark on a full-day tour of the Mekong Delta, Vietnam's agricultural heartland. Cruise along the Mekong River’s narrow canals, visiting fruit orchards, local villages, and traditional houses. Visit the beautiful Vinh Trang Pagoda, a serene Buddhist temple showcasing stunning architecture. Experience the peaceful countryside life before getting transferred to Ho Chi Minh City in the evening for an overnight stay.

items.title: Transfer in AC Shuttle Bus
items.desc: 1 X AC Shuttle Bus will be Provided

days.title: Transfer to Phnom Penh | Leisure Day
days.desc: Check out of the hotel and get transferred to Phnom Penh, the capital city of Cambodia. After your arrival, check in to your hotel and enjoy the rest of the day at leisure. You can take a stroll along the vibrant Sisowath Quay, a bustling riverfront promenade, lined with local cafes and restaurants. You can also visit Ounalom Monastery, a key spiritual hub in the city, or relax by the Riverfront, where you’ll witness scenic views of the Tonle Sap River, before returning to the hotel on your own.

items.title: Transfer in Toyota Commuter
items.desc: 1 X Toyota Commuter will be Provided

days.title: Phnom Penh City Tour
days.desc: Today, set out on a city sightseeing tour of Phnom Penh with key attractions like the Royal Palace and Silver Pagoda, known for their magnificent architecture and cultural significance. Visit Wat Phnom Temple, the city’s most iconic religious site, believed to be the birthplace of Phnom Penh. In the afternoon, gain a deeper understanding of Cambodia’s tragic history at the Tuol Sleng Genocide Museum and the Killing Fields. Later, get driven to the hotel for an overnight stay in Phnom Penh.

items.title: Transfer in Toyota Commuter
items.desc: 1 X Toyota Commuter will be Provided

days.title: Transfer to Siem Reap | Boat Ride on Tonle Sap Lake
days.desc: After checking out, get transferred to Siem Reap and upon arrival, check in at the hotel. Following this, enjoy a serene boat ride on Tonle Sap Lake, Southeast Asia’s largest freshwater lake. Witness the unique floating villages and learn about the way of life on the water. After your boat ride, get driven to the hotel in Siem Reap for an overnight stay.

days.title: Angkor Sightseeing
days.desc: On this day, board a transfer to spend the day exploring the magnificent temples of the Angkor Archaeological Park. Start your journey at the iconic Angkor Wat, then continue to Bayon Temple to admire its stunning stone faces. Visit the Leper King Terrace and explore Thommanon and Chau Say Tevoda, before taking a stroll through the Royal Enclosure (Royal Palace) of Angkor Thom. Conclude your day by getting transferred to the hotel in Siem Reap for an overnight stay.

days.title: Departure Day
days.desc: After checking out of your hotel, get transferred to the Siem Reap International Airport to board a flight for your departure to Chennai. This marks the end of one of our all-inclusive Vietnam and Cambodia tour packages from Chennai, leaving you with lasting memories of these incredible destinations.
